findings: Original, guide and four native crops confirm the diagonal main road and southeast access opening. Repeated northwest tree limbs and shadows cover sections of the outer margin, so a complete reliable boundary remains unavailable. The indeterminate verdict, null target and empty objects are supported.

The southern paved corridor is visible, while the northern fixed endpoint is within dense collapsed structural material and crowns. Native crops confirm that concealed northern margins cannot be recovered as a complete road polygon. Retain indeterminate without inventing hidden boundaries.

The native-size original and guide show the narrow north-south paved route, but crowns and dark shade cover repeated sections of both margins. The small vehicle near A alone does not establish obstruction. Full-width delineation remains unresolved, supporting the null target and indeterminate verdict.

Two native crops confirm the diagonal paved route beside the building and connected broad forecourt. The main-road edge cannot be traced continuously through the paved merge near A, and damaged vegetation covers portions of the southeast margin. Retain indeterminate rather than treating all connected paving as road or inventing a hidden edge.

Three native crops show the residential road, its curve, visible margins, driveway vehicles and nearby scattered material. B is beyond the diagonal usable-image limit in black pixels, leaving the terminal cross-section and final road portion unobservable. Retain indeterminate, null target and empty objects; vehicles alone do not establish obstruction.

Two native crops confirm the junction and southeast-curving access road. Small light objects are visible on or near the bend, but B and the adjoining final margins are beyond the diagonal image-data limit. A complete fixed A/B road polygon cannot be drawn, so indeterminate remains appropriate.

The original and guide were inspected at native size. The middle east-west road is visible, but B falls in the black unavailable region and crowns hide A and the eastern bend. Neither full terminal pair nor complete margins can be observed. Retain indeterminate with null target and no asserted objects.

Three native crops confirm visible paving at A and a middle fragment, separated by extensive black unavailable areas along the fixed diagonal interval. B and substantial portions of both road margins have no usable imagery. Retain indeterminate; missing imagery does not establish physical absence.
